DwG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilg.gov.ph DILG OPINION No. 05 s. 2022 JAN 19, 2022 HON. RICARDO MORALES Sangguniang Barangay Member Brgy. Landing, Municipality of Limay Province of Bataan Dear SB Member Morales: This has reference to your electronic mail dated 13 July 2021 wherein you are requesting for a legal opinion regarding the interpretation of the imposition of your penalty by virtue of the Sangguniang Bayan Resolution 2020-197. Specifically, you are requesting a legal opinion on the following issues, which we quoted in toto: "I. That I should be charged for Misconduct in Office and Conduct Prejudicial to the Best Interest of the Service which according to SB Resolution 2020-197 carry the penalty of six (6) months for my failure to submit proper documents proving that the Barangay liquidated the financial assistance given by Limay LGU through the then Mayor Ver Roque for disposal of solid waste; provide the require documentation and retum the excess fund. 2. That the Other offense of Gross insubordination which carry another 6 months penalty should be set aside because it is already within the context of Misconduct in Office and Conduct Prejudicial to the Best Interest of the Service where I was already penalized for 6 months. 3. Assuming that I am correct in no. 2 above that I should be suspended for 6 months only from Dec IO 2020 and hence, I should have resumed my office as Acting Barangay Chairman on June 10, 2021 4. On the other hand granting that the SB was correct that I should be suspended for I year, what are the legal requirements for me to be presented to Sangguniang Bayan when I assume office on Dec 10, 2021 " As to query numbers 1 to 3, this Department is proscribed, under our internal rules as provided in Memorandum Circular No. 2010-02, to act on queries to act on queries of the following kind, to wit: "2. Those presumptively valid acts. e.g. enacted ordinances. consummated acts that already enjoy the presumption of regularity on the part of the public officer concemed and similar instances; Considering that Sangguniang Bayan Resolution 2020-197 was already issued, we shall defer from commenting on the same because the propriety of every Resolution "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline NO.: 8876-34-54

and Ordinance must properly be questioned before the regular court. Correspondingly, questioning or discussing the propriety of the penalty imposed by the Sangguniang Bayan would be interfering with the functions of the local government unit (LGU) which enjoys local autonomy. Besides, there are remedies set forth under the law (i.e. Section 67 on Administrative Appeal under the LGC) that may be availed of by the aggrieved party to contest the decision of the Sangguniang Bayan. As to query number 4, Section 46 (b) of the LGC is instructive, thus: "SECTION 46. Temporary Vacancy in the Office of the Local Chief Executive. - (a) When the governor, city or municipal Mayor, or Punong Barangay is temporarily incapacitated to perform his duties for physical or legal reasons such as, but not limited to, leave of absence, travel abroad, and suspension from office, the vice-govemor, city or municipal vice-mayor, or the highest ranking Sangguniang Barangay member shall automatically exercise the powers and perform the duties and functions of the local chief executive concerned, except the power to appoint, suspend, or dismiss employees which can only be exercised if the period of temporary incapacity exceeds thirty (30) working days. (b) Said temporary incapacity shall terminate upon submission to the appropriate Sanggunian of a written declaration by the local chief executive concerned that he has reported back to office. In cases where the temporary incapacity is due to Ieqal causes. the local chief executive concerned shall also submit necessary documents showing that said legal causes no lonqer exist. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very trulyyours, By the Authority of the M N B.
